WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS trader_count
  FROM transactionrecord AS tr
  JOIN trader AS t
    ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
), stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(trader_count) AS avg_count,
         SUM(trader_count) AS total_count
  FROM type_counts
)
SELECT tc.tradekind,
       tc.trader_count,
       1.0 * tc.trader_count / s.total_count AS share_of_total,
       tc.trader_count - s.avg_count AS above_average
FROM type_counts AS tc
CROSS JOIN stats AS s
WHERE s.avg_count IS NOT NULL
  AND tc.trader_count > s.avg_count;
